name: Thermospheric density calibration (JB2008 temperature corrections)
description: JB2008 thermospheric mass density at points (propagator/hpop's JB2008, driven by SET SOLFSMY/DTCFILE rows as hpop reads them) with an exospheric-temperature correction field dT(latitude, local solar time) in Schmidt semi-normalized spherical harmonics added to JB2008's DSTDTC; and the estimation of that field, per time bin, from observed densities (Gauss-Newton on log-density residuals with a Gaussian prior and robust editing): a public, simplified analogue of the Dynamic Calibration of the Atmosphere in HASDM.

sequentialJustification.detail: Deterministic density evaluation and least squares over caller-supplied points, drivers and observations. No host calls, threads or network access.

methods.displayName: Evaluate JB2008 with a temperature correction

wildcardJustification.detail: {points: {mjd, latDeg, lonDeg, altKm} (UTC MJD, geodetic WGS84) | raw: [{mjd, sunRaRad, sunDecRad, lonRad, latRad, altKm, inputs[9]}], jb2008: {rows: PRW JB2008_INDICES rows as JSON}, correction?: {degree, segments: [{fromMjd, toMjd, coefficients}]}, derivative?: bool}

inputPorts.description: Points, drivers and the optional correction.

wildcardJustification.detail: {density [kg/m^3], deltaT [K], lstHours, dLnRhoDT [1/K] when asked, refused [indices]}

methods.displayName: Estimate temperature corrections from observed densities

wildcardJustification.detail: {points: {mjd, latDeg, lonDeg, altKm, rho, weight?} | raw (with rho), jb2008: {rows}, degree, binHours, fromMjd, toMjd, logSigma, priorSigmaK [per degree], minPoints, iterations, editSigma}

inputPorts.description: Observed densities and the estimation settings.

wildcardJustification.detail: {degree, binHours, bins: [{fromMjd, toMjd, n, used, coefficients [K], sigmas [K], prefitRms, postfitRms, iterations, converged}]}
